function.arguments: {"observation": "The `patient_id` column has 48 duplicate values, and `sample_seq` indicates that 48 patients were re-tested (i.e., appear in two rows). This means the dataset has multiple rows per patient, and we must deduplicate to ensure one row per patient before computing the mean biomarker_final.", "implication": "The population is defined as 'all patients in the trial, with one row per patient'. If we compute the mean across raw rows, we will double-weight the 48 re-tested patients. This biases the mean upward or downward depending on their `biomarker_final` values. We must deduplicate by `patient_id`, keeping the row with the highest `sample_seq` for each patient."}
function.name: note_finding
